game.title: Where Winds Meet
game.blurb: Open-world action RPG from Everstone Games, released 2025-11-14. RAWG average playtime: 3 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: The main story, its Qinghe ending and the Dark Surge stories. Spoiler-guarded; the hidden achievements sit here.

chapters.summary: Gear enhancement and tuning, Internal Arts, Martial Styles and mastering weapons.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has no page for "Where Winds Meet". wherewindsmeet.fandom.com answers the API, with 78 links (75 of them articles), including "Campaign Challenge", "Martial Arts", "Oddities", "Puzzles", "Taiping Mausoleum" and "Achievements"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema names the game "Where Winds Meet" (app 3564740, the only match). 8 of 67 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Regions (Qinghe, Kaifeng, Hexi) come from the achievement text. Several achievements name no place and were placed by their position in the list, which needs checking: "Quick on the Uptake - Qinghe" (its name gives the region), "A Fish Out of Water", "Egg-cellent Luck" and "A Squeak to Remember" (in the Hexi block); 46 to 60 (palace halls, a moonlit thief, mountains, flying) form their own block; 61 to 67 (Derndale, Penglai, Sea Shepherd, Mount Tai) were at 0.0% to 0.5% and look newest. "Qingzhou: Six-Art Savvy" says Penglai in its description. The all-achievements goal sits in the main story chapter. RAWG lists a playtime of only 3 hours, which looks low.
